test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

In order to __**earning decent living**__ we need to have a good job with a lucrative salary.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. earn a decent living .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence uses the phrase "In order to earning decent living," which is grammatically incorrect.
